clubs.name: ACM (BMSCE ACM Student Chapter)
clubs.overview: Established in 2021, the BMSCE ACM student chapter focuses on AI and ML concepts. It provides a platform for networking and collaboration among students and professionals, offering international perspectives in computer science.

clubs.name: Aquila Aerospace
clubs.overview: Aquila Aerospace is the student club of the department of aerospace engineering. It conducts technical and non-technical events for students and aerospace enthusiasts, encouraging the spirit of elevate, lift, fly.

clubs.name: Augment.AI
clubs.overview: The artificial intelligence club initiated by the ISE department. It spreads awareness on AI and ML through events, workshops, and accelerator programs, conducted quarterly.

clubs.name: AeroBMSCE
clubs.overview: AeroBMSCE, the Aeromodelling Club of BMSCE, is a vibrant community for aircraft and drone enthusiasts. The club participates in national and international aero-design competitions and offers a platform to learn, build and fly.

clubs.name: Robotics Club
clubs.overview: Focused on learning and innovation in robotics. Members design and program robotic systems, gaining hands-on experience while exploring creativity and engineering problem-solving.

clubs.name: Rocketry
clubs.overview: Rocketry is the model rocket club of BMSCE where students collaborate to design and work with rockets. The club provides a launchpad for project-based learning and rocket challenges, encouraging teamwork and exploration in rocket science.

clubs.name: Bullz Racing (SAE)
clubs.overview: The formula student team of BMSCE, designing and building formula-style race cars and competing in national-level motorsport competitions.

clubs.name: TeamCodeLocked
clubs.overview: TeamCodeLocked is the premier coding club of BMSCE, open to students from all branches; it focuses on coding proficiency via competitions, collaboration and workshops.

clubs.name: DSYNC (Data Science)
clubs.overview: The first data science club at BMSCE aimed at building strong coding, analytical, and collaborative skills among data science enthusiasts.

clubs.name: Varaince (AI & Data Science)
clubs.overview: A community centered around artificial intelligence and data science that runs seminars, hands-on sessions, hackathons and mentorship for aspiring AI/DS professionals.

clubs.name: CORTECHS
clubs.overview: CORTECHS (formerly AME) unites students passionate about MedTech and healthcare technology to reimagine healthcare solutions, empowering innovation across electronics, AI and healthcare.

clubs.name: CIIE (Centre for Innovation, Incubation & Entrepreneurship)
clubs.overview: CIIE supports student entrepreneurship, incubation & startup workshops and activities.

clubs.name: IIC BMSCE (Startup Cell)
clubs.overview: Institute Innovation Council / Startup Cell facilitating new ventures, events, and incubation activities.

clubs.name: EDC - Entrepreneur Development Cell
clubs.overview: EDC organises entrepreneurship development programs and workshops to build entrepreneurial skills.

clubs.name: Business Insights
clubs.overview: The business club of BMSCE aimed at inspiring entrepreneurship and managerial thinking through workshops, networking, and finance sessions.

clubs.name: Pentagram (Mathematics Society)
clubs.overview: The Mathematical Society promoting curiosity in mathematics via competitions, discussions and collaborative learning.

clubs.name: Mechanical Engineering Association (MEA)
clubs.overview: Club for mechanical engineering students conducting technical seminars, workshops and the departmental fest 'Dynamech' with an industry-orientated focus.

clubs.name: ELSOC (Electronics Society)
clubs.overview: ELSOC runs electronics workshops, project support and student activities focused on VLSI, robotics and related fields.

clubs.name: BMSCE IEEE Computer Society
clubs.overview: Supports development in computer science research and technology through workshops, seminars, hackathons, and networking.

clubs.name: BMSCE IEEE Student Branch
clubs.overview: Founded in 2009, the student branch organises technical activities to keep students updated with evolving technology.

clubs.name: BMSCE IEEE WIE
clubs.overview: Women in Engineering chapter promoting equality in STEM and professional skill development among women students.

clubs.name: IEEE PES & Sensors Council
clubs.overview: Focuses on power systems, sustainability and energy technologies through workshops and training.

clubs.name: IEEE Signal Processing Society
clubs.overview: Dedicated to signal processing theory and applications; organises conferences, workshops and knowledge sharing.

clubs.name: GDSC (Google Developer Student Club)
clubs.overview: A student-driven group promoting hands-on projects, workshops and innovation-focused activities.

clubs.name: Synapse (Biotech)
clubs.overview: The biotechnology students' association supporting academic growth through workshops, quizzes and hands-on training for young scientists.

clubs.name: Upagraha
clubs.overview: A student-driven satellite development initiative (with industry partners) involved in designing and launching a nanosatellite into low earth orbit.

clubs.name: <CodeIO/>
clubs.overview: A technical community in the CSE department focused on technical upskilling through hackathons, workshops, coding sessions, R&D activities and development projects such as web applications.

clubs.name: PROTOCOL
clubs.overview: The CSE departmental club focused on technical skill development. It conducts workshops, talks, competitions, and Protocol Day to enhance problem-solving and conceptual understanding in computer science.

clubs.name: Aquila
clubs.overview: Aquila Aerospace is the student club of the department of aerospace engineering. It conducts technical and non-technical events for students and aerospace enthusiasts, encouraging the spirit of elevate, lift, fly.

clubs.name: DSync
clubs.overview: The first data science club at BMSCE aimed at building strong coding, analytical and collaborative skills among data science enthusiasts.

clubs.name: ELSOC
clubs.overview: The student community of the ECE department conducting workshops and events to inspire innovation in VLSI, robotics, AI and other advanced technology domains.

clubs.name: ISE STUDENT CLUB
clubs.overview: A collaborative student-run club promoting holistic development, peer learning and community-building activities in the ISE department.

clubs.name: Synapse
clubs.overview: The first biotechnology students' association supporting academic and career growth through workshops, quizzes, themed events, hands-on training and community building among young scientists and innovators.

clubs.name: EEE Association
clubs.overview: A community for students interested in electrical and electronics engineering, organizing workshops, seminars and industrial visits to strengthen learning and innovation.

clubs.name: VarAInce
clubs.overview: A community centered around artificial intelligence and data science that runs seminars, hands-on sessions, hackathons and mentorship for aspiring AI/DS professionals.

clubs.name: Gradient
clubs.overview: The AIML club of BMSCE providing real-world project exposure and skill-building in artificial intelligence and application-based learning.

clubs.name: National Service Scheme (NSS)
clubs.overview: The NSS unit encourages social responsibility and community service. Members engage in welfare initiatives and volunteering activities, developing empathy, leadership, and teamwork.

clubs.name: Rotaract Club of BMSCE
clubs.overview: The Rotaract club of BMSCE is focused on community service, professional development and international service; members engage in impactful activities that build leadership and contribute to positive change.

clubs.name: Leo Satva
clubs.overview: Affiliated with Lions Clubs International, promoting leadership, service and community engagement through volunteer projects.

clubs.name: Mountaineering Club
clubs.overview: The Mountaineering Club promotes wall climbing, slacklining, bouldering, rappelling and hiking, organizing climbing trips and sustainable treks for beginners and experienced climbers.

clubs.name: Respawn (Gaming Club)
clubs.overview: The official gaming club hosting tournaments for popular competitive titles and providing a space for social and competitive gaming.

clubs.name: Inksanity – Literary & Debate Society
clubs.overview: The literary and debate society providing a platform for writing, debating, discussion, and creative expression.

clubs.name: Ninaad (Eastern Music)
clubs.overview: The Eastern music club promoting Carnatic, Hindustani, light, folk and film music; a space to learn, jam and perform.

clubs.name: The Groovehouse
clubs.overview: The music club hosting live performances, competitions and music-based cultural activities to foster a vibrant musical community.

clubs.name: Panache – Fashion Team
clubs.overview: The official fashion club of BMSCE hosting fashion shows, styling workshops and competitions for models, designers and makeup artists.

clubs.name: Paramvah Dance (Eastern)
clubs.overview: College dance team specializing in Eastern and Indian contemporary dance forms, creating expressive performances that celebrate cultural heritage.

clubs.name: Danz Addix (Western Dance)
clubs.overview: The western dance team performing hip-hop and contemporary styles, participating in events and competitions.

clubs.name: Fine Arts Club
clubs.overview: A platform for creativity involving drawing, sketching, mehendi, wall painting and other artistic expressions for all skill levels.

clubs.name: Falcons (Multimedia)
clubs.overview: The multimedia club comprising photographers, videographers, editors and drone operators who capture and document major college events.

clubs.name: Pravrutthi (Theatre)
clubs.overview: The theatre team involved in acting, scriptwriting, stage plays and street performances nurturing creativity and expressive storytelling.

clubs.name: Chiranthana (Kannada Sangha)
clubs.overview: The Kannada cultural club promoting Kannada language, literature and art with performances and cultural showcases.

clubs.name: Samskruthi Sambhrama
clubs.overview: The folklore society dedicated to celebrating Indian culture and heritage through diverse cultural art forms and performances.

clubs.name: BMS MUNSOC (Model UN)
clubs.overview: A platform for developing public policy awareness, diplomacy and oratory skills; members discuss, deliberate and resolve global issues.
